title: Anti-inflammatory effects of quinolinyl analog of resveratrol targeting TLR4 in MCAO/R ischemic stroke rat model.
authors: Xu, Libin; Mi, Yan; Meng, Qingqi; Liu, Yeshu; Wang, Feng; Zhang, Guijie; Liu, Yueyang; Chen, Guoliang; Hou, Yue
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究白藜芦醇类似物RV01通过靶向TLR4抑制NF-κB通路减轻脑缺血再灌注损伤，属于小分子-蛋白互作与神经炎症药理研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Among adults, stroke is the main causes of mortality and permanent disability. Neuroinflammation is one of the main causes of stoke-mediated neuronal death. Our previous study revealed that (E)-5-(2-(Quinolin-4-yl) vinyl) benzene-1, 3-diol (RV01), a quinolinyl analog of resveratrol, inhibits microglia-induced neuroinflammation and safeguards neurons from inflammatory harm. The preventive role of RV01 in ischemic stroke and its underlying cellular mechanisms and molecular targets remain poorly understood. PURPOSE: To investigate whether RV01 alleviates ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) injury by inhibiting microglia-mediated neuroinflammation and determine the potential molecular mechanisms and targets by which RV01 inhibits the I/R-mediated microglia activation. METHODS: Rat middle cerebral artery occlusion and reperfusion (MCAO/R) and BV-2 or primary microglial cells oxygen-glucose deprivation and reperfusion (OGD/R) models were established. The neurological behavior scores, 2, 3, 5-triphenyl tetrazolium chloride staining and immunofluorescence were used to detect the neuroprotective effect of RV01 in the MCAO/R rats. In addition, the mRNA expression levels of IL-6, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta were detected to reveal the antineuroinflammatory effect of RV01. Moreover, a western blot assay was performed to explore the protein expression changes in NF-kappaB-mediated neuroinflammation. Finally, we identified TLR4 as an RV01 target through molecular docking, drug sensitivity target stability analysis, cellular thermal shift analysis, and surface plasmon resonance techniques. RESULTS: RV01 reduced the infarct volume and neurological deficits, increased the rotarod duration, and decreased the number of rightward deflections in the MCAO/R rats. RV01 inhibited the NF-kappaB signaling pathway in vitro and in vivo, as demonstrated by the reduction in the transcription factor p65-mediated expression of several inflammatory factors including IL-6, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta. Further studies showed that its protective effect was associated with targeting the TLR4 protein. Notably, the anti-inflammatory effect of RV01 was markedly reinforced by the TLR4 knockdown, but inhibited by the overexpression of TLR4. Results revealed that the conditioned medium derived from the RV01-treated BV-2 cells significantly decreased the OGD/R-mediated neuronal damage. CONCLUSION: Our results are the first to reveal the protective effects of RV01 on cerebral ischemia, depending on its inhibitory effect on the NF-kappaB pathway by targeting TLR4. RV01 could be a potential protective agent in ischemic stroke treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：在成年人中，卒中（stroke）是死亡和永久性残疾的主要原因。神经炎症（neuroinflammation）是卒中介导神经元死亡的主要原因之一。我们先前的研究表明，(E)-5-(2-(喹啉-4-基)乙烯基)苯-1,3-二醇（RV01），一种白藜芦醇的喹啉基类似物，可抑制小胶质细胞诱导的神经炎症，并保护神经元免受炎症损伤。RV01在缺血性卒中中的预防作用及其潜在的细胞机制和分子靶点仍知之甚少。目的：探讨RV01是否通过抑制小胶质细胞介导的神经炎症来减轻缺血再灌注（I/R）损伤，并确定RV01抑制I/R介导的小胶质细胞活化的潜在分子机制和靶点。方法：建立大鼠大脑中动脉闭塞再灌注（MCAO/R）模型以及BV-2或原代小胶质细胞的氧糖剥夺再灌注（OGD/R）模型。采用神经行为评分、2,3,5-三苯基氯化四氮唑染色和免疫荧光检测RV01在MCAO/R大鼠中的神经保护作用。此外，检测IL-6、TNF-α和IL-1β的mRNA表达水平，以揭示RV01的抗神经炎症作用。进一步，通过蛋白质印迹实验探讨NF-κB介导的神经炎症中蛋白表达的变化。最后，通过分子对接、药物敏感性靶点稳定性分析、细胞热位移分析和表面等离子体共振技术，我们确定TLR4为RV01的靶点。结果：RV01减少了MCAO/R大鼠的梗死体积和神经功能缺损，增加了转棒持续时间，并减少了右偏次数。RV01在体外和体内抑制了NF-κB信号通路，表现为转录因子p65介导的多种炎症因子（包括IL-6、TNF-α和IL-1β）表达的降低。进一步研究表明，其保护作用与靶向TLR4蛋白相关。值得注意的是，RV01的抗炎作用在TLR4敲低时显著增强，但在TLR4过表达时受到抑制。结果显示，来自RV01处理的BV-2细胞的条件培养基显著减少了OGD/R介导的神经元损伤。结论：我们的结果首次揭示了RV01对脑缺血的保护作用，这依赖于其通过靶向TLR4对NF-κB通路的抑制作用。RV01可能成为缺血性卒中治疗中的潜在保护剂。
